scientific_integrity: Analytic generator and asymptotic proof; 265 reproducibility checks, finite numerical tests not substituted for infinite-time arguments.
scientific_limitations: Single harmonic particle, Poisson resets of Brownian driving noise to zero; exact stationary correlations. No extension to other reset laws, other potentials or out-of-stationarity measurements. Novelty assessment remains subject to unindexed literature and independent validation.
title: Sharp \(r=2\mu\) energy-correlation crossover for a harmonically trapped reset-noise particle
